name: Vimal Shah
profile: Kenyan industrialist born 1960 who in 1985 turned his family's textile business into soap maker Bidco with his father B.D. Shah and brother Tarun. Bidco grew into East Africa's leading maker of edible oils, detergents, personal care and food brands, with JVs incl. Wilmar and Land O'Lakes. He handed the CEO role to Thiagarajan Ramamurthy and remains chairman.
interesting_fact: The Bidco name comes from his father's initials, B.D. (Shah); the company operates in Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania and Madagascar.
deep_cut_fact: His first job, taken while at university, was selling life insurance on commission; he recalled that only about three or four in 100 prospects bought. He calls himself a workaholic who works from 5am to midnight.
notes: happy@bidcoafrica.com is Bidco's general company contact, not a personal one. He speaks often at regional business events (e.g. Building Bridges); LinkedIn or company channels are the best route.
